where: crates/blaze-lints, measuring a lint on a real crate
what: There is no way to run one blaze lint over a real workspace crate (blaze-std, blaze-mem) from a cargo-built test without a blaze daemon: no project loader in the tree, and fixtures cannot hold a crate with real core and its dependency graph, so site counts for the deny plan came from a text scan.
cause: the only path from a crate on disk to a lint run is blaze check
workaround: a syntactic upper bound counted by script (arith-logs/count_sites.py)
